# reforger-ai-mission-kit

> Toolkit for building Arma Reforger missions (Enfusion engine, Enforce Script) with an AI coding agent (Codex, Claude Code). It contains:
> - a working method;
> - Python tools: project scaffolding, resource and API indexes, resource registration, packing, a dedicated-server self-test runner, a real game-client test with screenshots, log summaries and map locations;
> - a mission template that compiles and passes its self-test;
> - documented engine pitfalls;
> - verified code recipes.
> Windows only. The documentation is in Spanish.

Start with AGENTS.md: it is the mandatory workflow and its rules. Then read docs/03-lecciones-enfusion.md (known pitfalls).

Key facts:
- **Workflow:** plan in small phases. For each phase: code → tools/server_test.py (self-test) → when something is visible, tools/pack.py + tools/client_test.py with screenshots in out/shots → commit → DEVLOG.
- **Never invent GUIDs, coordinates or API calls:**
  - GUIDs: tools/find.py (resource index of game, mods and projects).
  - Coordinates: tools/map_locations.py (named map locations with x y z).
  - API calls: tools/api.py (compact API generated locally from the official docs in Arma Reforger Tools).
- **Processes:** kill only processes you started. Never kill by executable name, and never close the user's Workbench or game. Run one test at a time: server and game both bind UDP 2001.
